article.title: What do barter exchanges imply about depressions and recessions?
article.excerpt: As was the case during the Great Depression , parallel currencies and barter exchanges are springing up around Spain and some other parts of Europe. Here is one account : Psychologist Angels Corcoles recently taught a seminar about self-empowerment for women, and when she finished the organizers handed her a check with her fee.
